_comment: BabySlakh pre-encoded with the streamgen accompaniment control. 'controls'/'controls_dim' split the fused {id}_controls.npy sidecar back into named streams and MUST match the channel order used at pre-encode time (see dataset2preencoding/local_babyslakh_streamgen.json). Uses the plain slakh metadata fn: the accompaniment is already baked into the sidecar, so no stem loading happens at train time.
